notes: Lokalex Native v3.0.17 (Build 317): Fixed creating/naming a customer from Sample Receipt Mode in Cart & Receipt Wizard so named custom drafts persist in the active Cart customer tabs and dropdown instead of snapping back to Sample Receipt Mode.

releases.headline: Sample Customer Naming Fix in Cart & Receipt Wizard
releases.notes: Fixed creating/naming a customer from Sample Receipt Mode in Cart & Receipt Wizard so named custom drafts persist in the active Cart customer tabs and dropdown selector instead of snapping back to blank Sample Receipt Mode.

releases.headline: Break Status Persistence & Break Allowance System Fixes
releases.notes: Fixed missing status='Break' persistence to Supabase roster (resolving Break reverting to Available for Admins, Inspectors, TLs, and Riders), added clock-in and active-Catering guards before entering Break, cleared stale prior-day totalBreakMinutes on daily rollover and new-day clock-in, and normalized Break Settings preset parsing/writing across both duration and minutes keys.

releases.headline: Manage Riders & Admin Settings Responsive Overlap Fix
releases.notes: Fixed overlapping and clipped controls in Manage (Riders) and Admin Settings modals: enabled responsive full-width sizing across all admin panels, anchored rider action buttons (Password, Edit, Delete) cleanly, wrapped credit/exempt and role/Powers/Access pills onto responsive rows, and hardened sibling admin dialogs.

releases.headline: Adaptive UI Settings, Menu Camera Edge Detection & Background Upload, and Sync Fixes
releases.notes: Added Directory Store Menu Camera (Single & Multi-Shot Bulk) with automatic menu edge detection and full-camera fallback, background menu photo uploads with a non-blocking foreground progress card, Adaptive UI Settings (resolution/DPI auto-fit, 1:1 scaling fix, responsive chrome, and phone-bounded element size slider), and fixes for Worker sync timeouts and left-composition cancellation errors.

releases.headline: End-Shift Inbox Done Fix & Live Chat Banned Folder
releases.notes: Fixed End-Shift users getting logged back in as Available when marking an Inbox chat Done, and added the Live Chat Banned folder with Ban Customer / Lift Ban controls (day/week/month/permanent duration, optional reason, confirmation modal, Admin/permitted TL access, and strict folder locking until unbanned).

releases.headline: Inbox/Done Chat Sync & Card Preview Stability Fix
releases.notes: Stopped chats with new customer replies from switching repeatedly between Done and Inbox, kept chat card previews on the latest message, merged duplicate customer chat records before tab filtering, and auto-reopened missed customer replies on Done threads.

releases.headline: Inbox Done & Available Lineup Fix
releases.notes: Fixed Inbox chats marked Done putting users into the Available lineup with a cooldown, and prevented re-lining up users who are already in the Available lineup.

releases.headline: Commission Fee Fix & Catering Status Sync Fix
releases.notes: Includes Handling, Market, Multi-stop fees and discounts properly in receipts, commissions, and daily gross (even after unlocking cart). Fixes the self-cater bug where riders stayed Available while customer chats jumped to Done and flipped back and forth.

releases.headline: Break Time Allowance Enforcement, Catering & Done Progress Modal, Cart Receipt Checkmarks & Chat Batching
releases.notes: Enforces 60-min daily break allowance limits for Riders and TLs (blocking new breaks at 0 mins) with accurate elapsed tracking. Extends foreground modal to Catering, Force Catering, and Done with 3s auto-closing countdown. Adds cart receipt checkmark badges, resolves repeat same-day orders, and optimizes chat history loading.

releases.headline: Status Confirmation Modal, Lineup Desync Fix, Daily Sync & Menu Downloader
releases.notes: Foreground modal with 3s auto-closing countdown confirms Available, Catering, Break, and End shifts with 3 cancelable auto-retries and signal check guidance. Fixes cross-device lineup desync and card text wrapping. Adds once-per-day directory sync and background store menu downloader.

releases.headline: Cart Draft Key Migration, N/A Items on Receipts & Sample Receipt Mode
releases.notes: Cart draft key migration prevents items disappearing when thread IDs connect. N/A items are clearly marked on receipts so customers see unavailable items. Sample receipts allow testing calculations without saving to database unless named to someone.

releases.headline: Cart Wizard Delivery Fee Guard, Queue Priority & Anti-Takeover Protection
releases.notes: Delivery fee guard prompts riders before generating receipts when not free delivery. Lineup queue priority protects waiting couriers, catering anti-takeover blocks sniping, and messenger reply quotes render original text.

releases.headline: Zero-Fallback Authoritative Commission, Fast 3s/10s Roster Polling & Peer Realtime Broadcast
releases.notes: Authoritative commission sync without stale disk fallbacks so voided orders drop instantly. 3s Rotations / 10s other tabs adaptive ETag polling, instant cellular tower reconnection, and sub-second peer status broadcast.

releases.headline: Hotfix: Startup Crash Fix (NPE in ChatConversationPane) & Version Downgrade/Update Manager
releases.notes: Resolved startup null pointer exception in ChatConversationPane and ChatFeedScreen when loading cached conversations. Added interactive version list in AppUpdateDialog allowing users to update or downgrade between released versions.

releases.headline: Hotfix: Startup & Login Crash Resolution, Layout Constraint & Gestures Hardening
releases.notes: Hotfix resolving startup and user login crash. Fixed unconstrained vertical measurement in ChatThreadListPane, offloaded user interaction sync to Dispatchers.IO, added deterministic tie-breaking to sortAvailableRiders.

releases.headline: Zero-Data Fast Reconnection, Lineup Fallback Hardening & Inbox Multi-Select
releases.notes: Zero-data fast user interaction reconnector with ETag 304 cache, zombie socket auto-healing, parallelized roster and login queries, and inbox long-press multi-select.

releases.headline: Admin Void Login, Ghost Status Protection & Team Leader Commission Inclusion
releases.notes: Admin Void / Cancel Login option in Logins modal to permanently delete accidental shift records and reset status to End.

releases.headline: Rider of the Week (ROTW), Performance Monitoring Filter, Team Leader Commission
releases.notes: Rider of the Week (ROTW) weekly automation, monitored riders filter in Performance Tracker, Team Leader commission inclusion & role badges.
